stemMd: Why was a separate pedestrian entrance useful?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It removed the need to consider event times

options.label: B
options.textMd: It converted the market into a theatre

options.label: C
options.textMd: It could reduce interference between audience movement and loading routes

options.label: D
options.textMd: It guaranteed that the old walls needed no repair

options.label: E
options.textMd: It made every journey shorter for every user

explanationMd: Separating pedestrian access addresses the shared-route part of the conflict. Combined with schedule changes, it reduces competition between audiences and market operations without assuming that the building shell alone determines success.

distractorRationale.d: Access separation does not establish structural condition.
distractorRationale.b: The neighbouring market retained its function.
distractorRationale.e: The passage does not establish universal travel savings.
